verses.text: Here are the names of Israel’s sons who came to Egypt with Jacob, each bringing his own family. 🧳
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah; 👥
Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin; 👥
Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher. 👥
Jacob’s family had seventy people in all, including Joseph, who was already in Egypt. 🔢
Joseph died, then all his brothers, and everyone from that generation. 🕊️
But Israel’s people kept having children. They multiplied, grew stronger, and filled the land. 🌱
Then a new king took power in Egypt—one who didn’t know Joseph. 👑
He told his people, ‘Look, the Israelites are now more numerous and stronger than we are. ⚠️
‘Come on, we need to move smart. If they keep multiplying, they could side with our enemies in a war, fight us, and leave the land.’ 🗣️
So the Egyptians put taskmasters over them to crush them with forced labor. The Israelites built Pharaoh’s storage cities, Pithom and Rameses. 🧱
But the more the Egyptians oppressed them, the more the Israelites multiplied and spread out. The Egyptians grew afraid of them. 📈
The Egyptians forced the Israelites into brutal labor. ⛓️
They made their lives bitter with hard work—mixing mortar, making bricks, and doing every kind of field labor. They treated them ruthlessly in all of it. 💔
Egypt’s king spoke to two Hebrew midwives, one named Shiphrah and the other Puah. 👥
He told them, ‘When you help Hebrew women give birth and see a boy on the birth stool, kill him. If it’s a girl, let her live.’ ⚠️
But the midwives respected God and didn’t do what Egypt’s king ordered. They let the boys live. 🙏
Egypt’s king called the midwives in and demanded, ‘Why did you do this? Why did you let the boys live?’ 👑
The midwives answered Pharaoh, ‘Hebrew women aren’t like Egyptian women. They’re strong and give birth before a midwife can get there.’ 🗣️
God treated the midwives well, and the people kept multiplying and growing very strong. 🌱
Because the midwives respected God, he gave them families of their own. 🙏
Then Pharaoh ordered all his people, ‘Throw every newborn Hebrew boy into the Nile, but let every girl live.’ 🌊
A man from Levi’s family married a woman from Levi’s family. 👨‍👩‍👦
She became pregnant and had a son. She saw he was a fine child, so she kept him hidden for three months. 👶
When she couldn’t hide him anymore, she made a papyrus basket, sealed it with tar and pitch, placed the baby inside, and set it among the reeds by the riverbank. 🧺
His sister stood a little way off, watching to see what would happen to him. 👀
Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe in the river while her attendants walked along the bank. She spotted the basket among the reeds and sent her servant to get it. 🌊
She opened it and saw the baby crying. She felt compassion for him and said, ‘This must be one of the Hebrew children.’ 🥺
The baby’s sister asked Pharaoh’s daughter, ‘Should I find a Hebrew woman to nurse the baby for you?’ 💬
Pharaoh’s daughter said, ‘Go.’ So the young woman went and called the baby’s mother. 🏃
Pharaoh’s daughter told her, ‘Take this baby and nurse him for me. I’ll pay you.’ So the woman took her child and nursed him. 🤱
The child grew up, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, who adopted him as her son. She named him Moses, saying, ‘I pulled him out of the water.’ 💧
When Moses had grown up, he went out to where his people were working and saw their heavy labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew—one of his own people. 👀
Moses looked around. Seeing no one, he killed the Egyptian and buried him in the sand. ⚠️
The next day he went out again and saw two Hebrew men fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, ‘Why are you hitting your fellow Hebrew?’ 🗣️
The man answered, ‘Who made you our boss and judge? Are you going to kill me like you killed the Egyptian?’ Moses became afraid and thought, ‘People know what I did.’ 😨
When Pharaoh heard about it, he tried to kill Moses. But Moses ran from Pharaoh and settled in Midian, where he sat down by a well. 🏃
The priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came to draw water and fill the troughs for their father’s flock. 🐑
Some shepherds came and drove them away, but Moses stood up for them and watered their flock. 💪
When they got back to their father Reuel, he asked, ‘How did you get back so early today?’ 🏠
They said, ‘An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds. He even drew water for us and watered the flock.’ 💧
He asked his daughters, ‘Where is he? Why did you leave him there? Go invite him in so he can eat.’ 🍽️
Moses agreed to stay with the man, who gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses as a wife. 💍
She had a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, ‘I’ve been a foreigner in a foreign land.’ 👶
After a long time, Egypt’s king died. The Israelites groaned under their slavery and cried out for help; their cry rose up to God. 😢
God heard their groaning and remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. 🙏
God saw the Israelites and understood what they were going through. 💔
Moses was tending the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law and Midian’s priest. He led the flock deep into the wilderness and reached Horeb, God’s mountain. 🐑
Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire coming from a bush. Moses looked—and the bush was burning, but it wasn’t getting used up. 🔥
Moses said, ‘I’ve got to go closer and check out this amazing sight. Why isn’t the bush burning up?’ 👀
When Yahweh saw Moses coming over to look, God called to him from the bush: ‘Moses! Moses!’ He answered, ‘I’m here.’ 🗣️
God said, ‘Don’t come any closer. Take off your sandals, because the ground you’re standing on is holy.’ 🩴
He said, ‘I am the God of your father—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God. 🙏
Yahweh said, ‘I’ve seen how badly my people are suffering in Egypt. I’ve heard them crying out under their taskmasters. I know their pain. 💔

‘I’ve come down to rescue them from the Egyptians and bring them out of that land to a good, spacious land, flowing with milk and honey—the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites. 🗺️
‘Their cry has reached me. I’ve also seen how the Egyptians are crushing them. 😢
‘So come on—I’m sending you to Pharaoh. Bring my people, Israel, out of Egypt.’ 📣
Moses said to God, ‘Who am I to go to Pharaoh and bring Israel out of Egypt?’ 😟
God said, ‘I’ll be with you. Here’s your sign that I’m the one sending you: after you bring the people out of Egypt, you’ll worship God on this mountain.’ 🕊️
Moses said to God, ‘When I go to the Israelites and say, “Your ancestors’ God sent me,” they’ll ask, “What’s his name?” What should I tell them?’ ❓
God said to Moses, ‘I AM WHO I AM.’ Then he said, ‘Tell the Israelites: “I AM sent me to you.”’ ✨
God also said to Moses, ‘Tell the Israelites: “Yahweh, your ancestors’ God—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—sent me to you.” This is my name forever, remembered through every generation. 📜
‘Go gather Israel’s elders and tell them: “Yahweh, your ancestors’ God—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—appeared to me and said, ‘I’ve come to you and seen what’s being done to you in Egypt. 🗣️
“‘I’ve decided to bring you out of Egypt’s suffering and into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’”’ 🗺️

‘They’ll listen to you. Then you and Israel’s elders must go to Egypt’s king and tell him, “Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, met with us. Please let us travel three days into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to Yahweh our God.”’ 🙏
‘I know Egypt’s king won’t let you go—not even under pressure. ⚠️
‘So I’ll reach out and strike Egypt with all the wonders I’ll perform there. After that, he’ll let you go. 🌟
‘I’ll make the Egyptians look favorably on these people. When you leave, you won’t go empty-handed. 🎁

‘Every woman should ask her Egyptian neighbor and any woman staying in her home for silver and gold jewelry and clothing. Put these on your sons and daughters. In this way, you’ll take wealth from Egypt with you.’ 💛
Moses answered, ‘But what if they don’t believe me or listen? They’ll say, “Yahweh never appeared to you.”’ 😟
Yahweh asked him, ‘What do you have in your hand?’ Moses said, ‘A staff.’ 🪵
Yahweh said, ‘Throw it on the ground.’ Moses did, and it turned into a snake. Moses jumped back from it. 🐍
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Reach out and grab it by the tail.’ He did, and it turned back into a staff in his hand. 🪄
Yahweh said, ‘This will help them believe that Yahweh—the God of their ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—really appeared to you.’ 📜
Yahweh then told him, ‘Put your hand inside your cloak.’ Moses did. When he pulled it out, his hand was diseased and white as snow. ✋
Yahweh said, ‘Put your hand inside your cloak again.’ Moses did, and when he pulled it out, it was healthy again like the rest of his skin. ✨
‘If they don’t believe you or listen to the first sign, they may believe the second one. 🪧
‘If they still don’t believe either sign or listen to you, take some water from the river and pour it on the dry ground. The water will turn to blood there.’ 🌊
Moses said to Yahweh, ‘Please, Lord, I’ve never been a good speaker—not before, and not even now that you’ve spoken to me. Words come slowly for me.’ 😟
Yahweh said, ‘Who made the human mouth? Who makes someone unable to speak or hear, or able to see or blind? Isn’t it me, Yahweh? 👁️
‘Now go. I’ll be with you when you speak and teach you what to say.’ 🕊️
Moses said, ‘Please, Lord, send someone else.’ 🙏
Yahweh became angry with Moses and said, ‘What about your brother Aaron the Levite? I know he speaks well. Look, he’s already coming out to meet you, and he’ll be happy to see you. 🤝
‘You’ll tell him what to say, and I’ll help both of you speak and teach you what to do. 🗣️
‘He’ll speak to the people for you. He’ll be your spokesperson, and you’ll be like God to him.’ 📣
‘Take this staff with you. Use it to perform the signs.’ 🪵
Moses went back to his father-in-law Jethro and said, ‘Please let me return to my people in Egypt and see if they’re still alive.’ Jethro told him, ‘Go in peace.’ 🏠
While Moses was in Midian, Yahweh told him, ‘Go back to Egypt. Everyone who wanted to kill you is dead.’ 📨
Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey, and headed back to Egypt. He carried God’s staff in his hand. 🫏
Yahweh told Moses, ‘When you get back to Egypt, perform in front of Pharaoh all the wonders I’ve put in your power. But I’ll make his heart stubborn, and he won’t let the people go. ⚠️
‘Then tell Pharaoh, “Yahweh says: Israel is my son, my firstborn. 👑
“‘I told you, ‘Let my son go so he can worship me,’ but you refused. So now I will kill your firstborn son.”’ ⚠️
On the way, at a place where they stopped for the night, Yahweh confronted Moses and was about to kill him. 🌙
Zipporah took a flint knife and circumcised her son. She threw the foreskin at his feet and said, “You are a bridegroom of blood to me.” 🪨
Then Yahweh let Moses alone. Zipporah said, ‘A bridegroom of blood,’ because of the circumcision. 🕊️
Yahweh told Aaron, ‘Go into the wilderness and meet Moses.’ Aaron went and met him at God’s mountain, then kissed him. 🏔️
Moses told Aaron everything Yahweh had sent him to say and all the signs he’d been told to perform. 🗣️
Then Moses and Aaron went and gathered all Israel’s elders. 👥
Aaron told them everything Yahweh had said to Moses and performed the signs in front of the people. ✨
The people believed. When they heard Yahweh had come to help Israel and had seen their suffering, they bowed down and worshiped. 🙏
After that, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, ‘This is what Yahweh, Israel’s God, says: “Let my people go, so they can hold a feast for me in the wilderness.”’ 📣
Pharaoh replied, ‘Who is Yahweh that I should listen to him and let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and I’m not letting Israel go.’ 👑
They said, ‘The Hebrews’ God met with us. Please let us travel three days into the wilderness and offer a sacrifice to Yahweh our God. Otherwise, he may strike us with disease or the sword.’ 🙏
Egypt’s king said, ‘Moses and Aaron, why are you pulling the people away from their work? Get back to your jobs!’ 😠
Pharaoh added, ‘There are already a lot of people in the land, and now you’re making them stop working.’ 🗣️
That same day, Pharaoh gave orders to the taskmasters and Israel’s foremen: 📣
‘Stop giving the people straw for making bricks like before. Make them go find straw for themselves. 🌾
‘But still demand the same number of bricks from them. Don’t cut their quota at all. They’re lazy—that’s why they’re saying, “Let us go offer sacrifices to our God.” 🧱
‘Pile more work on them so they stay busy. Don’t let them listen to lies.’ ⚠️
The taskmasters and foremen went out and told the people, ‘This is Pharaoh’s order: “I won’t give you straw. 📣
‘“Go find straw wherever you can, but your brick quota stays exactly the same.”’ 🌾
So the people spread all across Egypt, gathering stalks and scraps to use as straw. 🏃
The taskmasters kept rushing them: ‘Meet your daily quota, just like when you had straw!’ ⏱️
Pharaoh’s taskmasters beat Israel’s foremen and demanded, ‘Why didn’t you meet your brick quota yesterday or today like before?’ ⚠️
Then Israel’s foremen went to Pharaoh and pleaded, ‘Why are you treating your servants like this? 😟
‘You don’t give us straw, but they tell us, “Make bricks!” Look, we’re getting beaten, even though your own people are at fault.’ 💔
Pharaoh said, ‘You’re lazy—lazy! That’s why you keep saying, “Let us go offer sacrifices to Yahweh.”’ 😠
‘Now get back to work! You won’t get straw, but you still have to make the same number of bricks.’ 🧱
Israel’s foremen realized they were in serious trouble when they heard, ‘You can’t reduce the daily brick quota at all.’ 😰
They met Moses and Aaron, who were waiting along the road as they came from Pharaoh’s palace. 🚶
They said, ‘May Yahweh look at what you’ve done and judge you! You’ve made us stink in Pharaoh’s eyes and his officials’ eyes, and handed them an excuse to kill us!’ 😡
Moses went back to Yahweh and said, ‘Lord, why have you brought trouble on these people? Why did you send me? 🙏
‘Ever since I went to Pharaoh speaking in your name, he’s made things worse for them. You haven’t rescued your people at all!’ 😔
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Now you’ll see what I’m about to do to Pharaoh. I’ll use my mighty hand, and he’ll let them go—he’ll drive them out of his land.’ 💪
God spoke to Moses: ‘I am Yahweh. 📣
‘I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as God Almighty, but I wasn’t known to them by my name Yahweh. 📜
‘I also made my covenant with them: I promised to give them Canaan, the land where they traveled and lived as foreigners. 🤝
‘I’ve heard the Israelites groaning under Egyptian slavery, and I’ve remembered my covenant. 😢
‘So tell the Israelites: “I am Yahweh. I’ll bring you out from under Egypt’s heavy burdens, free you from slavery, and rescue you with my outstretched arm and mighty acts of judgment. 🛡️
“‘I’ll take you as my own people, and I’ll be your God. Then you’ll know I’m Yahweh your God—the one who brought you out from under Egypt’s burdens. 🤝
“‘I’ll bring you into the land I promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I’ll give it to you as your own. I am Yahweh.’” 🗺️
Moses told this to the Israelites, but they didn’t listen. Their spirits were crushed by harsh slavery. 😔
Then Yahweh spoke to Moses: 📣
‘Go tell Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, to let the Israelites leave his land.’ 📨
Moses answered Yahweh, ‘Look, the Israelites didn’t listen to me. Why would Pharaoh listen? I struggle to speak clearly.’ 😟
Yahweh gave Moses and Aaron a command for the Israelites and for Pharaoh, Egypt’s king: bring the Israelites out of Egypt. 📣
These are the heads of their family groups. Reuben was Israel’s firstborn; his sons were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These are Reuben’s clans. 👨‍👦
Simeon’s sons were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, whose mother was a Canaanite woman. These were Simeon’s clans. 👨‍👦
Here are Levi’s sons by their family lines: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived 137 years. 🌳
Gershon’s sons were Libni and Shimei, with their own family lines. 👨‍👦
Kohath’s sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years. 🌳
Merari’s sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans by family line. 👨‍👦
Amram married Jochebed, his father’s sister. She gave birth to Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years. 👨‍👩‍👦
Izhar’s sons were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri. 👨‍👦
Uzziel’s sons were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri. 👨‍👦
Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon. She gave birth to Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. 👨‍👩‍👦
Korah’s sons were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans. 👨‍👦
Eleazar son of Aaron married one of Putiel’s daughters, and she gave birth to Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families and clans. 👨‍👩‍👦
This is the same Aaron and Moses Yahweh told, ‘Bring the Israelites out of Egypt in their organized groups.’ 📜
These are the same Moses and Aaron who spoke to Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, about bringing Israel out of Egypt. 🗣️
On the day Yahweh spoke to Moses in Egypt, 🗓️
he told him, ‘I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, everything I tell you.’ 📣
Moses answered Yahweh, ‘I struggle to speak clearly. How will Pharaoh listen to me?’ 😟
Yahweh said to Moses, ‘Look, I’m making you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will speak for you. 🗣️
‘You’ll tell Aaron everything I command you. He’ll speak to Pharaoh and tell him to let the Israelites leave his land. 📣
‘I’ll make Pharaoh stubborn, and I’ll do many signs and wonders in Egypt. ✨
‘Pharaoh won’t listen. So I’ll strike Egypt and bring my people Israel out—their families and tribes—through great acts of judgment. ⚖️
‘When I stretch out my hand over Egypt and bring Israel out, the Egyptians will know I am Yahweh.’ 🛡️
Moses and Aaron did exactly what Yahweh commanded them. ✅
Moses was eighty years old and Aaron was eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh. 🔢
Yahweh told Moses and Aaron: 📣
‘When Pharaoh says, “Show me a miracle,” tell Aaron, “Take your staff and throw it down in front of Pharaoh.” It’ll turn into a snake.’ 🐍
Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did what Yahweh commanded. Aaron threw down his staff in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it turned into a snake. 🐍
Then Pharaoh called in his wise men and sorcerers. Egypt’s magicians did the same thing with their secret arts. 🎩
Each one threw down his staff, and they turned into snakes. But Aaron’s staff swallowed their staffs. 🐍
Still, Pharaoh became stubborn and wouldn’t listen, just as Yahweh had said. 😠
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go. ⚠️
‘Go meet Pharaoh in the morning when he heads to the river. Stand by the riverbank with the staff that turned into a snake in your hand. 🌅
‘Tell him: “Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, sent me to say, ‘Let my people go worship me in the wilderness.’ But until now you haven’t listened.” 📨
‘This is what Yahweh says: “Here’s how you’ll know I am Yahweh: I’ll strike the river water with the staff in my hand, and it’ll turn to blood. 🩸
“‘The fish in the river will die, the river will stink, and the Egyptians won’t be able to drink its water.”’ 🌊

‘Tell Aaron: “Take your staff and stretch out your hand over Egypt’s waters—rivers, canals, ponds, and every pool. They’ll all turn to blood. Blood will be everywhere in Egypt, even in wooden and stone containers.”’ 🩸
Moses and Aaron did what Yahweh commanded. Aaron raised the staff and struck the river in front of Pharaoh and his officials. All the river water turned to blood. 🩸
The fish died, the river stank, and the Egyptians couldn’t drink its water. Blood spread throughout Egypt. 💔
Egypt’s magicians used their secret arts to do the same. Pharaoh stayed stubborn and wouldn’t listen, just as Yahweh had said. ⚠️
Pharaoh turned around, went back to his palace, and didn’t even take it to heart. 🏛️
The Egyptians dug along the riverbank looking for water to drink, because they couldn’t drink from the river. ⛏️
Seven days passed after Yahweh struck the river. 🗓️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go to Pharaoh and tell him, “Yahweh says: Let my people go worship me. 📣
“‘If you refuse, I’m sending frogs all over your land. 🐸
“‘The river will swarm with frogs. They’ll come into your house, your bedroom, your bed, your officials’ homes, your people’s homes, your ovens, and your dough bowls. 🐸
“‘Frogs will come up over you, your people, and all your officials.”’ 🐸
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Tell Aaron: “Stretch your staff over Egypt’s rivers, streams, and pools, and make frogs come up over the land.”’ 🪄
Aaron stretched his hand over Egypt’s waters, and frogs came up and covered the land. 🐸
Egypt’s magicians did the same with their secret arts and brought frogs over Egypt too. 🎩
Then Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, ‘Ask Yahweh to take the frogs away from me and my people. Then I’ll let the people go offer sacrifices to Yahweh.’ 🙏
Moses said to Pharaoh, ‘You decide when I should pray for you, your officials, and your people. When should the frogs leave you and your homes and stay only in the river?’ 🗓️
Pharaoh said, ‘Tomorrow.’ Moses replied, ‘It’ll happen as you say, so you’ll know there’s no one like Yahweh our God. 🌅
‘The frogs will leave you, your homes, your officials, and your people. They’ll remain only in the river.’ 🐸
Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh. Moses cried out to Yahweh about the frogs he had brought on Pharaoh. 🙏
Yahweh did what Moses asked. The frogs died in the houses, courtyards, and fields. 🐸
People piled the dead frogs into heaps, and the land stank. 🤢
But when Pharaoh saw there was relief, he became stubborn and wouldn’t listen to Moses and Aaron, just as Yahweh had said. 😠
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Tell Aaron: “Raise your staff and strike the ground. The dust will turn into lice throughout Egypt.”’ 🪄
They did it. Aaron stretched out his hand with his staff and struck the dust. Lice got on people and animals; all the dust across Egypt turned into lice. 🦟
The magicians tried using their secret arts to make lice too, but they couldn’t. Lice were on people and animals. 🦟
The magicians told Pharaoh, ‘This is God’s doing!’ But Pharaoh stayed stubborn and wouldn’t listen, just as Yahweh had said. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Get up early and stand before Pharaoh when he goes to the water. Tell him, “Yahweh says: Let my people go worship me. 🌅
“‘If you don’t let them go, I’ll send swarms of flies on you, your officials, and your people. Your homes will be full of flies, and they’ll cover the ground too. 🪰
“‘But that day I’ll set Goshen apart, where my people live. No flies will swarm there. Then you’ll know I, Yahweh, am here in this land. 🛡️
“‘I’ll make a clear distinction between my people and yours. This sign will happen tomorrow.”’ ✨
Yahweh did it. Huge swarms of flies filled Pharaoh’s palace and his officials’ homes. Flies ruined the whole land of Egypt. 🪰
Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and said, ‘Go offer sacrifices to your God here in the land.’ 🗣️
Moses said, ‘That wouldn’t be right. What we sacrifice to Yahweh our God is detestable to the Egyptians. If we do it in front of them, won’t they stone us? ⚠️
‘We’ll travel three days into the wilderness and offer sacrifices to Yahweh our God, as he tells us.’ 🏜️
Pharaoh said, ‘I’ll let you go into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to Yahweh your God. Just don’t go very far. Pray for me.’ 🗣️
Moses said, ‘I’m leaving now. I’ll pray to Yahweh so the flies leave you, your officials, and your people tomorrow. But don’t trick us again by refusing to let the people go worship Yahweh.’ 🙏
Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to Yahweh. 🙏
Yahweh did what Moses asked and removed the flies from Pharaoh, his officials, and his people. Not one fly remained. 🪰
But Pharaoh became stubborn again and wouldn’t let the people go. 😠
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go to Pharaoh and tell him: “This is what Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go worship me. 📣
“‘If you keep refusing and hold them back, ⚠️
“‘Yahweh’s hand will bring a terrible disease on your livestock out in the fields—your horses, donkeys, camels, cattle, and sheep. 🐄
“‘Yahweh will treat Israel’s livestock differently from Egypt’s. Not one animal belonging to Israel will die.”’ 🛡️
Yahweh set the time and said, ‘Tomorrow I’ll do this in the land.’ 🗓️
The next day Yahweh did it. All Egypt’s livestock died, but not one animal belonging to Israel died. 🐄
Pharaoh sent someone to check, and not one Israelite animal had died. But Pharaoh stayed stubborn and wouldn’t let the people go. 👑
Yahweh told Moses and Aaron, ‘Take handfuls of soot from a furnace. Moses must toss it into the air in front of Pharaoh. 🔥
‘It’ll become fine dust over all Egypt, causing painful boils and sores on people and animals throughout the land.’ 😷
They took furnace soot and stood before Pharaoh. Moses tossed it into the air, and painful boils and sores broke out on people and animals. 😷
The magicians couldn’t even stand in front of Moses because of the boils; the sores were on them and all the Egyptians. 😣
But Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn, and Pharaoh wouldn’t listen, just as Yahweh had told Moses. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Get up early tomorrow and stand before Pharaoh. Tell him: “This is what Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go worship me. 🌅
“‘This time I’m sending all my plagues against you, your officials, and your people, so you’ll know no one in the whole world is like me. 🌍
“‘By now I could have reached out, struck you and your people with disease, and wiped you off the earth. ⚠️
“‘But I’ve kept you standing for this reason: to show you my power and make my name known throughout the whole world. 📣
“‘Yet you still set yourself against my people and refuse to let them go. 😠
“‘Tomorrow around this time I’ll send such a terrible hailstorm that Egypt has never seen anything like it—not since it became a nation. 🌩️
“‘So now, get your livestock and everything you own out in the fields under shelter. Any person or animal left outside will be hit by the hail and die.”’ 🏠
Some of Pharaoh’s officials respected Yahweh’s warning. They rushed their servants and livestock indoors. 🏃
But whoever didn’t take Yahweh’s warning seriously left their servants and livestock out in the fields. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Reach your hand toward the sky, and hail will fall on every person, animal, and plant throughout Egypt.’ 🌩️
Moses raised his staff toward the sky. Yahweh sent thunder and hail, and lightning flashed down to the earth. Hail poured over Egypt. 🌩️
It was the worst hailstorm Egypt had ever seen since it became a nation, with lightning flashing through the storm. ⛈️
The hail struck everything in the fields—people, animals, plants, and trees—and shattered every tree out there. 🌳
But there was no hail in Goshen, where the Israelites lived. 🛡️
Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, ‘This time I’ve sinned. Yahweh is right; my people and I are in the wrong. 🙏
‘Pray to Yahweh. We’ve had enough thunder and hail! I’ll let you go; you don’t have to stay any longer.’ ⛈️
Moses said, ‘As soon as I leave the city, I’ll spread my hands out to Yahweh. The thunder will stop, and there won’t be any more hail. Then you’ll know the earth belongs to Yahweh. 🙏
‘But I know that you and your officials still don’t truly respect Yahweh God.’ 😔
The hail ruined the flax and barley, because the barley had formed heads and the flax was flowering. 🌾
But the wheat and spelt weren’t ruined because they hadn’t grown yet. 🌱
Moses left Pharaoh’s city and spread his hands out to Yahweh. The thunder and hail stopped, and the rain quit falling on the ground. 🌧️
When Pharaoh saw the rain, hail, and thunder had stopped, he sinned again. He and his officials became stubborn all over again. 😠
Pharaoh stayed stubborn and wouldn’t let the Israelites go, just as Yahweh had said through Moses. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go to Pharaoh. I’ve made his heart and his officials’ hearts stubborn so I can show them my signs, 📣
‘and so you can tell your children and grandchildren what I did to Egypt and what signs I performed there. Then you’ll know I am Yahweh.’ 📖
Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, ‘This is what Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, says: “How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go worship me. ⚖️
“‘If you refuse, tomorrow I’ll bring locusts into your land. 🦗
“‘They’ll cover the ground so completely you won’t see it. They’ll eat whatever the hail left behind, including every tree growing in your fields. 🌳
“‘They’ll fill your houses, your officials’ houses, and every Egyptian’s house—more than your ancestors or their ancestors ever saw.’” Then Moses turned and left Pharaoh. 🏠
Pharaoh’s officials asked him, ‘How long is this man going to keep trapping us? Let the people go worship Yahweh their God! Don’t you see Egypt is ruined?’ 😟
Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. He said, ‘Go worship Yahweh your God. But who exactly is going?’ ❓
Moses replied, ‘We’re all going—young and old, sons and daughters, flocks and herds. We have to hold a feast for Yahweh.’ 👨‍👩‍👧
Pharaoh said, ‘May Yahweh be with you if I let you take your little ones! You’re clearly planning trouble. 😠
‘No! Only the men can go worship Yahweh—that’s what you asked for!’ Then Moses and Aaron were driven out of Pharaoh’s presence. 🚪
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Reach your hand over Egypt. Let the locusts come and eat every plant the hail left behind.’ 🦗
Moses raised his staff over Egypt, and Yahweh sent an east wind across the land all day and night. By morning, the wind had brought the locusts. 🌬️
Locusts spread over all Egypt and settled across the whole country. It was a devastating swarm—nothing like it had ever been before, and nothing like it would happen again. 🦗
They covered the ground until it went dark, and ate every plant and every bit of fruit the hail had spared. Nothing green remained on any tree or plant anywhere in Egypt. 🌑
Pharaoh quickly called Moses and Aaron back. He said, ‘I’ve sinned against Yahweh your God and against you. 🙏
‘Please forgive my sin just this once. Pray to Yahweh your God to take this deadly plague away from me.’ 😔
Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to Yahweh. 🙏
Yahweh sent a powerful west wind that swept the locusts away and carried them into the Red Sea. Not one locust remained anywhere in Egypt. 🌬️
But Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn, and he wouldn’t let Israel’s people go. ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Reach your hand toward the sky, and darkness will cover Egypt—darkness so thick you can feel it.’ 🌑
Moses reached his hand toward the sky, and thick darkness covered Egypt for three days. 🌑
People couldn’t see one another, or get up and move around for three days. But every Israelite home had light. 🕯️
Pharaoh called Moses and said, ‘Go worship Yahweh. You can take your children too, but leave your flocks and herds behind.’ 🗣️
Moses answered, ‘You also have to give us animals for sacrifices and burnt offerings, so we can sacrifice to Yahweh our God. 🐑
‘Our own livestock is coming too—not one hoof will stay behind. We need the animals to worship Yahweh our God, and we won’t know which ones we’ll need until we get there.’ 🐄
But Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn, and he refused to let them go. ⚠️
Pharaoh said to Moses, ‘Get out of here! Don’t ever show your face to me again. The day you see me again, you’ll die!’ 😠
Moses answered, ‘Fine. You won’t see my face again.’ 🚪
Yahweh told Moses, ‘I’m bringing one last plague on Pharaoh and Egypt. After that, Pharaoh will let you go. When he does, he’ll force you out completely. ⚠️
‘Tell the people that every man and woman should ask their Egyptian neighbors for silver and gold jewelry.’ 💛
Yahweh made the Egyptians look favorably on Israel. Moses had also become highly respected throughout Egypt—in Pharaoh’s officials’ eyes and among the people. 👑
Moses said, ‘This is what Yahweh says: “Around midnight, I’ll go through the middle of Egypt. 🌙
“‘Every firstborn in Egypt will die—from Pharaoh’s firstborn son sitting on the throne to the firstborn of the servant girl working at the mill, and even the firstborn of the livestock. ⚠️
“‘There will be a huge cry across Egypt, unlike anything before or anything that will come after. 😢
“‘But not even a dog will bark at any Israelite, whether person or animal. Then you’ll know Yahweh treats Egypt and Israel differently. 🐕
“‘All your officials will come down to me, bow low, and say, “Leave—you and everyone following you!” After that, I’ll go.’” Moses left Pharaoh, furious with anger. 😠
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Pharaoh won’t listen to you, so my wonders will increase throughout Egypt.’ ✨
Moses and Aaron had performed all these wonders in front of Pharaoh, but Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn. He still wouldn’t let Israel’s people leave his land. ⚠️
Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Egypt: 📣
‘This month will mark the start of your calendar. It will be your first month of the year. 🗓️
‘Tell all Israel: On the tenth day of this month, each man must choose a lamb for his family—a lamb for each household. 🐑
‘If a household is too small to eat a whole lamb, share one with the nearest neighbor. Count people according to how much each person can eat. 🍽️
‘Choose a flawless year-old male lamb. It can come from the sheep or the goats. 🐑
‘Keep it until the fourteenth day of the month. Then, at twilight, the whole Israelite community must slaughter it. 🌆
‘Take some of its blood and brush it on the two doorposts and the top beam of each house where you eat. 🩸
‘That night, eat the meat roasted over fire, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs. 🍞
‘Don’t eat it raw or boiled in water. Roast it over fire—with its head, legs, and inner parts. 🔥
‘Don’t leave any of it until morning. If anything remains by morning, burn it up. 🔥
‘Eat like people ready to leave: belt fastened, sandals on, staff in hand. Eat quickly. This is Yahweh’s Passover. 🏃
‘That night I’ll pass through Egypt and strike every firstborn—people and animals. I’ll judge all Egypt’s gods. I am Yahweh. ⚖️
‘The blood on your houses will be your sign. When I see it, I’ll pass over you; no plague will destroy you when I strike Egypt. 🩸
‘Remember this day. Celebrate it as a feast to Yahweh, generation after generation. Keep it as a lasting rule. 📜
‘For seven days, eat unleavened bread. On day one, clear yeast out of your homes. Anyone who eats leavened bread from day one through day seven must be cut off from Israel. 🍞
‘Hold a sacred gathering on the first day and another on the seventh. Don’t do regular work on those days; only prepare the food each person needs to eat. 🙏
‘Keep the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because on this very day I brought your divisions out of Egypt. Keep this day through every generation as a lasting rule. 📜
‘Starting at sunset on the fourteenth day of the first month, eat unleavened bread until sunset on the twenty-first day. 🌙
‘For seven days, don’t let yeast be found in your homes. Anyone who eats leavened bread must be cut off from Israel’s community, whether foreign-born or native. 🚫
‘Eat nothing made with yeast. Wherever you live, eat unleavened bread.’ 🍞
Moses called Israel’s elders together and said, ‘Go choose lambs for your families and slaughter the Passover lamb. 🐑
‘Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it in the basin of blood, and brush the blood on the top beam and both doorposts. No one may leave the house until morning. 🩸
‘Yahweh will pass through to strike Egypt. When he sees blood on the top beam and doorposts, he’ll pass over the doorway and won’t let the destroyer enter your homes to strike you. 🛡️
‘Keep this as a lasting rule for you and your children. 📜
‘When you arrive in the land Yahweh promised to give you, continue this ceremony. 🗺️
‘When your children ask, “What does this ceremony mean?” 👧
‘Tell them: “It’s Yahweh’s Passover sacrifice. He passed over Israel’s homes in Egypt when he struck the Egyptians and spared our families.”’” The people bowed down and worshiped. 🙏
Then Israel’s people went and did exactly what Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron. ✅
At midnight, Yahweh struck every firstborn in Egypt—from Pharaoh’s firstborn son on the throne to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon—and all the firstborn livestock. ⚠️
Pharaoh got up in the night, along with all his officials and all Egypt. A terrible cry went up, because there wasn’t one home without someone dead. 😢
During the night, Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron: ‘Get up! Leave my people—you and all the Israelites. Go worship Yahweh, just as you said! 📣
‘Take your flocks and herds too, just as you asked. Go—and bless me as well!’ 🐑
The Egyptians urgently pushed the people to leave the land fast. They said, ‘If you stay, we’re all going to die!’ 🏃
The people carried their dough before it could rise, with their kneading bowls wrapped in clothes and slung over their shoulders. 🎒
Israel’s people did what Moses had told them. They asked the Egyptians for silver and gold jewelry and clothing. 💛
Yahweh made the Egyptians look favorably on the people, so they gave them what they asked for. Israel carried off Egypt’s wealth. 🎁
Israel’s people traveled from Rameses to Succoth. About six hundred thousand men walked, not counting the children. 🧳
A mixed crowd went with them too, along with huge flocks and herds of livestock. 🐑
They baked unleavened cakes from the dough they had brought out of Egypt. They had been rushed out and couldn’t wait or prepare food for the journey. 🍞
Israel’s people had lived in Egypt for 430 years. ⏳
At the end of 430 years, on that very day, all Yahweh’s divisions marched out of Egypt. 🏃
That night is to be kept watch for Yahweh, because he brought them out of Egypt. All Israelites must keep watch on this night, generation after generation. 🌙
Yahweh told Moses and Aaron, ‘Here are the rules for Passover: no foreigner may eat it. 📜
‘Any male slave bought with money may eat it after he has been circumcised. ✂️
‘A foreign visitor or hired worker may not eat it. 🚫
‘Eat it in one house. Don’t carry any of the meat outside, and don’t break any of its bones. 🏠
‘The whole Israelite community must celebrate it. 🤝

‘If a foreign resident living among you wants to celebrate Passover to Yahweh, all his males must be circumcised. Then he may celebrate and be treated like someone born in the land. No uncircumcised person may eat it. ✂️
‘The same rule applies to anyone born in the land and to the foreign resident living among you.’ ⚖️
All Israel’s people did just what Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron. ✅
That very day, Yahweh brought Israel’s people out of Egypt, organized in their divisions. 🏃
Yahweh told Moses: 📣
‘Set apart for me every firstborn male—the first to open the womb among Israel’s people and animals. They belong to me.’ 👶
Moses told the people, ‘Remember this day—you came out of Egypt, out of slavery. Yahweh brought you out with his mighty hand. Don’t eat bread made with yeast. 🧳
‘You’re leaving today, in the month of Abib. 🗓️

‘When Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites—the land he swore to give your ancestors, flowing with milk and honey—keep this ceremony during this month. 🗺️
‘Eat unleavened bread for seven days, and on the seventh day hold a feast to Yahweh. 🍞
‘Eat unleavened bread throughout all seven days. Don’t let leavened bread or yeast be seen anywhere in your territory. 🚫
‘On that day, tell your child, “I’m doing this because of what Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.” 👨‍👧
‘Let this be a sign on your hand and a reminder in front of your eyes, so Yahweh’s teaching stays in your mouth. Yahweh brought you out of Egypt with his mighty hand. ✋
‘Keep this rule at its appointed time, year after year. 📅
‘When Yahweh brings you into the Canaanite land, as he promised you and your ancestors, and gives it to you, 🗺️
‘set apart for Yahweh every firstborn male. The firstborn males of your livestock belong to Yahweh too. 🐑
‘Redeem every firstborn donkey with a lamb. If you don’t redeem it, break its neck. Redeem every firstborn son among your children. 🐑
‘When your child later asks, “What does this mean?” tell him, “Yahweh brought us out of Egypt, out of slavery, with his mighty hand. 👨‍👦

“‘“When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed every firstborn in Egypt, human and animal. That’s why I sacrifice every firstborn male animal to Yahweh, and redeem each firstborn son.”’ ⚠️
‘Let this be a sign on your hand and a reminder in front of your eyes: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand.’ ✋

When Pharaoh finally let the people go, God didn’t lead them along the Philistine route, even though it was shorter. God thought, ‘If they see war, they might change their minds and go back to Egypt.’ 🧭
So God led the people around through the wilderness toward the Red Sea. Israel’s people left Egypt organized for battle. 🏜️
Moses took Joseph’s bones with him. Joseph had made Israel’s people swear, ‘God will surely come to your aid, and when he does, carry my bones up from here with you.’ 🦴
They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness. 🏕️
Yahweh went ahead of them in a cloud column by day to guide their journey, and in a fire column by night to light the way, so they could travel by day and night. ☁️
The cloud column never left its place ahead of the people by day, and the fire column never left by night. 🔥
Yahweh told Moses: 📣
‘Tell Israel’s people to turn back and camp in front of Pi-Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, opposite Baal-Zephon. Camp beside the sea. 🏕️
‘Pharaoh will think, “They’re lost in the land. The wilderness has trapped them.” 🧭
‘I’ll make Pharaoh stubborn so he chases after you. Then I’ll show my glory over Pharaoh and his whole army, and Egypt will know I am Yahweh.’ The people did as they were told. ⚔️
When Egypt’s king heard the people had left, he and his officials changed their minds: ‘What have we done? We let Israel go from serving us!’ 😠
So Pharaoh got his chariot ready and took his army with him. 🐎
He took six hundred of his best chariots, all Egypt’s other chariots, and commanders over every one. 🛡️
Yahweh made Pharaoh stubborn, and Egypt’s king chased Israel. Meanwhile, Israel’s people were leaving boldly. 🏃
The Egyptians chased them with Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, horsemen, and army. They caught up while Israel camped by the sea near Pi-Hahiroth, opposite Baal-Zephon. 🐎
When Pharaoh came close, Israel looked up and saw the Egyptians coming after them. They panicked and cried out to Yahweh. 😨
They said to Moses, ‘Were there no graves in Egypt? You brought us out here to die in the wilderness! Why did you do this to us? 😟
‘Didn’t we tell you back in Egypt, “Leave us alone; let us serve the Egyptians”? It would’ve been better to serve them than die out here!’ 😣
Moses told the people, ‘Don’t be afraid. Stand firm and watch Yahweh rescue you today. You’ll never see these Egyptians coming after you again. 🛡️
‘Yahweh will fight for you. Stay calm.’ 🕊️
Yahweh asked Moses, ‘Why are you crying out to me? Tell Israel’s people to move forward. 📣
‘Raise your staff and stretch your hand over the sea. Divide the water, and Israel’s people will walk through the sea on dry ground. 🌊
‘I’ll make the Egyptians stubborn too, and they’ll follow you into the sea. I’ll show my glory over Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen. ⚔️
‘When I show my glory over Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen, Egypt will know I am Yahweh.’ ✨
God’s angel, who had been leading Israel’s camp, moved behind them. The cloud column moved from the front and stood behind them too. ☁️
It came between Egypt’s camp and Israel’s camp. The cloud brought darkness on one side and light by night on the other. The two camps stayed apart all night. 🌙
Moses stretched his hand over the sea. Yahweh drove the water back with a strong east wind all night, turned the seabed into dry ground, and split the waters apart. 🌬️
Israel’s people walked through the middle of the sea on dry ground, with water like a wall on their right and left. 🌊
The Egyptians chased after them into the middle of the sea—all Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen. 🐎
During the morning watch, Yahweh looked down at the Egyptian army from the fire and cloud columns and threw their camp into confusion. 🌅
He jammed their chariot wheels so they struggled to drive. The Egyptians said, ‘Let’s get away from Israel! Yahweh is fighting for them against us!’ 🛞
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Stretch your hand over the sea. Let the water come back over the Egyptians, their chariots, and their horsemen.’ 📣
Moses stretched his hand over the sea. As morning came, the sea returned to its usual strength. The Egyptians tried to flee, but Yahweh swept them into the sea. 🌊
The water came back and covered the chariots, horsemen, and Pharaoh’s entire army that had followed Israel into the sea. Not one survived. ⚠️
But Israel’s people walked on dry ground through the middle of the sea, with water like a wall on their right and left. 🌊
That day Yahweh rescued Israel from the Egyptians. Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore. 🛡️
Israel saw the mighty work Yahweh had done against Egypt. The people revered Yahweh, trusted Yahweh, and trusted his servant Moses. 🙏
Then Moses and Israel’s people sang this song to Yahweh: ‘I’ll sing to Yahweh—he has won a glorious victory! He threw horse and rider into the sea. 🎶
‘Yahweh is my strength and my song. He rescued me. He is my God, and I’ll praise him; my father’s God, and I’ll honor him. 🙌
‘Yahweh is a warrior. Yahweh is his name. ⚔️
‘He threw Pharaoh’s chariots and army into the sea. His best officers sank in the Red Sea. 🌊
‘Deep water covered them. They sank to the depths like a stone. 🪨
‘Yahweh, your right hand is powerful and glorious! Your right hand smashes the enemy. 💪
‘With your great majesty, you knock down those who rise against you. You send out your anger, and it burns them up like dry straw. 🔥
‘One breath from you piled the waters up. The waves stood like a wall; the depths froze in the middle of the sea. 🌊
‘The enemy bragged, “I’ll chase them down, catch them, and divide the loot. I’ll get everything I want. I’ll draw my sword and wipe them out!” 😠
‘But you blew your wind, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters. 🌬️
‘Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you—glorious in holiness, awesome in praise, doing wonders? ✨
‘You stretched out your right hand, and the earth swallowed them. 🌍
‘In your loyal love, you led the people you redeemed. In your strength, you guided them to your holy home. 🛡️
‘The nations heard and shook. The people of Philistia were seized with terror. 😨
‘Edom’s chiefs panicked; Moab’s mighty men trembled; everyone living in Canaan lost heart. 🌍
‘Terror and dread fell over them. Your mighty arm made them still as stone until your people crossed over—the people you bought for yourself. 🪨
‘You’ll bring them in and plant them on your mountain, the land you chose as your home—the sanctuary, Lord, that your hands established. 🏔️
‘Yahweh will reign forever and ever!’ 👑
That’s what they sang because Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen went into the sea, and Yahweh brought the waters back over them—while Israel walked on dry land through the sea. 🌊
Miriam the prophet, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine. All the women followed her with tambourines and dancing. 🥁
Miriam sang back to them: ‘Sing to Yahweh—he has won a glorious victory! He threw horse and rider into the sea!’ 🎶
Moses led Israel away from the Red Sea and into the wilderness of Shur. They traveled for three days but couldn’t find water. 🏜️
When they reached Marah, they couldn’t drink its water because it was bitter. That’s why the place was named Marah, meaning ‘Bitter.’ 💧
The people complained to Moses, ‘What are we supposed to drink?’ 😟
Moses cried out to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a piece of wood. Moses threw it into the water, and the water turned sweet. There Yahweh gave the people a rule and instruction, and tested them. 🌿

Yahweh said, ‘If you carefully listen to the voice of Yahweh your God, do what is right in his eyes, pay attention to his commands, and keep all his rules, I won’t put on you the diseases I brought on Egypt. I am Yahweh, your healer.’ 🕊️
Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees. They camped beside the water. 🌴
Israel’s people set out from Elim and reached the Wilderness of Sin, between Elim and Sinai. It was the fifteenth day of the second month since they left Egypt. 🏜️
The whole Israelite community started grumbling against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness. 😠
They said, ‘We wish Yahweh had let us die in Egypt! Back there we sat by cooking pots and ate all the bread we wanted. You brought us out here to starve this whole crowd to death!’ 😣
Yahweh told Moses, ‘I’m going to rain bread from the sky for you. Every day the people will go out and gather enough for that day. I’ll test whether they follow my instructions. 🍞
‘On the sixth day, they’ll gather twice as much and prepare it.’ 🧺
Moses and Aaron told all the Israelites, ‘By evening, you’ll know Yahweh brought you out of Egypt. 🌆
‘In the morning, you’ll see Yahweh’s glory, because he heard you grumbling against him. Who are we, that you grumble against us?’ 🌅

Moses said, ‘This evening Yahweh will give you meat, and in the morning he’ll give you all the bread you want. Yahweh heard you grumbling against him. Who are we? You’re grumbling against Yahweh, not us.’ 🗣️
Moses told Aaron, ‘Tell the whole Israelite community, “Come close to Yahweh—he heard your complaints.”’ 🙏
As Aaron spoke to the community, they looked toward the wilderness, and Yahweh’s glory appeared in the cloud. ☁️
Yahweh told Moses: 📣
‘I heard Israel’s complaints. Tell them: “This evening you’ll eat meat, and in the morning you’ll have all the bread you want. Then you’ll know I am Yahweh your God.”’ 🍽️
That evening, quail covered the camp. In the morning, dew lay all around it. 🐦
When the dew dried up, a small, round substance lay on the wilderness ground, fine as frost. ❄️
When the Israelites saw it, they asked each other, ‘What is this?’ They didn’t know what it was. Moses told them, ‘This is the bread Yahweh has given you to eat. 🍞
‘Here’s Yahweh’s instruction: everyone should gather what they need to eat—one omer per person, according to how many people are in each tent.’ 🧺
Israel’s people did so. Some gathered more, and some gathered less. ⚖️
When they measured it by the omer, the ones who gathered a lot had nothing left over, and the ones who gathered a little still had enough. Each person gathered what they needed to eat. 🤝
Moses told them, ‘Don’t leave any of it until morning.’ 🌅
But some people didn’t listen to Moses. They left some until morning, and it bred worms and stank. Moses was angry with them. 🐛
Every morning they gathered what they needed. When the sun got hot, the rest melted. ☀️
On the sixth day they gathered twice as much—two omers per person. All the community’s leaders came and reported it to Moses. 🧺
Moses said, ‘Yahweh told us: “Tomorrow is a day of complete rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil. Save whatever is left for the morning.”’ 🕊️
They saved it until morning, just as Moses ordered. It didn’t stink, and no worms got into it. ✅
Moses said, ‘Eat it today. Today is Yahweh’s Sabbath. You won’t find any of it in the fields today. 🍞
‘Gather it for six days, but the seventh day is Sabbath. There won’t be any then.’ 📅
On the seventh day, some people still went out to gather, but they found nothing. 🚫
Yahweh said to Moses, ‘How long will you refuse to keep my commands and instructions? ⚠️
‘Look, Yahweh gave you the Sabbath. That’s why on the sixth day he gives you bread for two days. Everyone stay where you are; no one should leave their place on the seventh day.’ 🕊️
So the people rested on the seventh day. 🛌
Israel’s people named the bread ‘manna.’ It looked like white coriander seed and tasted like wafers with honey. 🍯
Moses said, ‘Yahweh commanded: “Keep one full omer of this bread through every generation, so they can see the bread I fed you with in the wilderness after bringing you out of Egypt.”’ 🫙
Moses told Aaron, ‘Take a jar, put a full omer of manna in it, and keep it before Yahweh through every generation.’ 🫙
Aaron stored it before the Testimony, just as Yahweh commanded Moses, so it could be kept. 📜
Israel’s people ate manna for forty years, until they reached settled land. They ate it until they reached Canaan’s border. ⏳
An omer is one-tenth of an ephah. 📏
Israel’s whole community left the Wilderness of Sin and traveled from place to place, following Yahweh’s instructions. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for them to drink. 🏜️
So the people argued with Moses: ‘Give us water to drink!’ Moses said, ‘Why are you coming at me? Why are you testing Yahweh?’ 😠
The people were thirsty, and they complained to Moses: ‘Why bring us out of Egypt? So our children and livestock can die of thirst out here?’ 😟
Moses cried out to Yahweh: ‘What am I supposed to do with these people? They’re almost ready to stone me!’ 😰
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go out ahead of the people. Take some of Israel’s elders with you, and take the staff you used to strike the Nile. Go. 🪵
‘I’ll be standing there in front of you on the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out for the people to drink.’ Moses did this while Israel’s elders watched. 💧
Moses named the place Massah and Meribah, because Israel’s people argued there and tested Yahweh by asking, ‘Is Yahweh really with us or not?’ ❓
Then Amalek came to fight Israel at Rephidim. ⚔️
Moses told Joshua, ‘Choose some men for us and go fight Amalek. Tomorrow I’ll stand on the hilltop with God’s staff in my hand.’ 🗣️
Joshua did what Moses told him and fought Amalek. Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the hilltop. 🏔️
Whenever Moses held his hand up, Israel had the advantage. Whenever he lowered his hand, Amalek had the advantage. ✋
Moses’ hands got tired. So they put a stone under him and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur stood beside him, one on each side, holding up his hands until sunset. 🤝
Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the sword. ⚔️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Write this down in a scroll as a reminder, and make sure Joshua hears it: I’ll completely erase Amalek’s memory from under the sky.’ 📜
Moses built an altar and named it ‘Yahweh Is My Banner.’ 🏳️
He said, “Yahweh has sworn: Yahweh will be at war with Amalek from generation to generation.” ⚔️
Jethro, Midian’s priest and Moses’ father-in-law, heard how God had helped Moses and Israel, and how Yahweh brought Israel out of Egypt. 📨
After Moses had sent his wife away, Jethro brought Zipporah back to him, 💍
along with their two sons. One son was named Gershom, because Moses said, ‘I’ve been a foreigner in a foreign land.’ 👨‍👩‍👦
The other was named Eliezer, because Moses said, ‘My father’s God helped me and rescued me from Pharaoh’s sword.’ 🛡️
Jethro came to Moses in the wilderness where he was camped near God’s mountain. He brought Moses’ wife and sons with him. 🏕️
He sent word to Moses: ‘I, Jethro your father-in-law, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons.’ 📨
Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, bowed, and kissed him. They asked how each other was doing, then went into the tent. 🤝
Moses told Jethro everything Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and Egypt for Israel, all the hardships they faced on the way, and how Yahweh rescued them. 🗣️
Jethro was glad to hear all the good Yahweh had done for Israel by rescuing them from Egypt. 🙌
Jethro said, ‘Blessed be Yahweh! He rescued you from Egypt and Pharaoh, and pulled his people out from under Egypt’s power. 🙏
‘Now I know Yahweh is greater than all gods, because he rescued people from those who treated them arrogantly.’ ✨
Jethro brought a burnt offering and other sacrifices for God. Aaron and all Israel’s elders came to eat a meal with Moses’ father-in-law before God. 🍽️
The next day, Moses sat down to settle the people’s disputes. They stood around him from morning until evening. ⚖️
When Jethro saw everything Moses was doing for the people, he asked, ‘Why are you doing this all by yourself, while everyone stands around from morning to evening?’ 😮
Moses answered his father-in-law, ‘The people come to me to ask God what to do. 🙏
‘When they have a dispute, they bring it to me. I decide between one person and another, and explain God’s rules and instructions to them.’ ⚖️
Jethro said, ‘The way you’re handling this isn’t good. ⚠️
‘You’ll wear yourself out, and the people with you too. This job is too heavy to carry alone. 😓
‘Listen to my advice, and may God be with you. You should represent the people before God and bring their cases to him. 🤝
‘Teach them God’s rules and instructions. Show them the way to live and the work they should do. 📜
‘Also choose capable people from among the people—people who respect God, tell the truth, and reject dishonest gain. Put them in charge of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens. 👥
‘Let them judge the people regularly. They can handle smaller cases themselves, but bring every major case to you. That will make your load lighter, because they’ll carry it with you. ⚖️
‘If you do this and God approves, you’ll be able to keep going, and everyone can return home in peace.’ 🕊️
Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he advised. 👂
Moses chose capable men from all Israel and put them in charge of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens. 👥
They judged the people regularly. They brought the difficult cases to Moses and handled the smaller ones themselves. ⚖️
Then Moses said goodbye to his father-in-law, and Jethro went back to his own land. 🧳
In the third month after Israel’s people left Egypt, on that very day, they arrived in the Wilderness of Sinai. 🏜️
They had left Rephidim and reached Sinai’s wilderness. There they camped in front of the mountain. 🏕️
Moses went up to God. Yahweh called to him from the mountain: ‘This is what you must tell Jacob’s family and Israel’s people: 📣
“‘You saw what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you here on eagles’ wings and brought you close to me. 🦅
“‘Now, if you listen carefully to my voice and keep my covenant, you’ll be my treasured people among all nations. The whole earth belongs to me, 🌍
“‘but you will be my kingdom of priests, my holy nation.’ These are the words you must tell Israel’s people.” 🙏
Moses came back, called Israel’s elders together, and repeated everything Yahweh had commanded him. 🗣️
All the people answered together, ‘We’ll do everything Yahweh has said.’ Moses brought their answer back to Yahweh. 🤝
Yahweh told Moses, ‘I’m coming to you in a thick cloud, so the people can hear me speaking with you and trust you always.’ Moses reported the people’s answer to Yahweh. ☁️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go to the people. Set them apart today and tomorrow, and have them wash their clothes. 🧼
‘Have them ready for the third day. On that day Yahweh will come down on Mount Sinai where all the people can see. 🏔️
‘Set a boundary around the mountain for the people, and warn them: “Don’t climb the mountain or touch its edge. Anyone who touches it must be put to death. 🚫
“‘No one may touch that person. They must be stoned or shot with arrows—whether person or animal, they must die.” When the trumpet sounds long, the people may come up to the mountain.’ 📯
Moses went down to the people and set them apart for the meeting. They washed their clothes. 🧼
He told the people, ‘Be ready for the third day. Don’t have sex during this time.’ 📅
On the morning of the third day, thunder and lightning struck, a thick cloud covered the mountain, and a very loud trumpet sounded. Everyone in the camp trembled. ⛈️
Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God. They stood at the foot of the mountain. 🏔️
Mount Sinai was covered in smoke because Yahweh came down on it in fire. Smoke rose like smoke from a furnace, and the whole mountain shook violently. 🔥
As the trumpet kept getting louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him with a voice. 📯
Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. He called Moses up, and Moses went up. 🏔️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go down and warn the people not to push through to see me. Many could die. ⚠️
‘The priests who approach Yahweh must set themselves apart too, or Yahweh may break out against them.’ 🙏
Moses said to Yahweh, ‘The people can’t come up Mount Sinai. You already warned us: “Set a boundary around the mountain and make it holy.”’ 🗣️
Yahweh told him, ‘Go down, then come back up with Aaron. But don’t let the priests or people push through to approach me, or I may break out against them.’ 📣
So Moses went down to the people and told them. 🗣️
God spoke all these words: 📜
‘I am Yahweh your God. I brought you out of Egypt, out of slavery. 🛡️
‘You must not have any other gods besides me. 🙏
‘Don’t make an idol for yourself or an image of anything in the sky above, on the earth below, or in the water under the earth. 🚫
‘Don’t bow down to them or serve them. I, Yahweh your God, am jealous for your loyalty. I bring the consequences of parents’ sin on the third and fourth generations of those who hate me, ⚖️
I show faithful love to thousands who love me and keep my commands. ❤️
‘Don’t misuse the name of Yahweh your God. Yahweh won’t treat anyone who misuses his name as innocent. 📣
‘Remember the Sabbath day and keep it holy. 🕊️
‘Work for six days and do all your work, 🛠️
‘but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. Don’t work—you, your son or daughter, your male or female servant, your livestock, or the foreigner staying in your town. 🛌
‘Yahweh made the sky, earth, sea, and everything in them in six days, then rested on the seventh. That’s why Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy. 🌍
‘Honor your father and mother, so you can live long in the land Yahweh your God is giving you. 👨‍👩‍👧
‘Do not murder. 🛑
‘Do not commit adultery. 💍
‘Do not steal. 🚫
‘Do not lie about your neighbor in court. ⚖️
‘Do not desire your neighbor’s house. Don’t desire your neighbor’s wife, male or female servant, ox, donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.’ 🏠
The people heard the thunder, saw the lightning, heard the trumpet blast, and saw the mountain covered in smoke. They trembled and stayed far away. ⛈️
They said to Moses, ‘You speak to us, and we’ll listen. Don’t let God speak to us, or we’ll die.’ 😨
Moses told the people, ‘Don’t be afraid. God came to test you, so reverence for him will stay with you and keep you from sinning.’ 🙏
The people stayed back, while Moses went closer to the thick darkness where God was. ☁️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Tell Israel’s people: “You saw for yourselves that I spoke with you from heaven. ☁️
“‘Don’t make silver or gold gods to stand alongside me. 🚫
“‘Make an altar of earth for me. Offer your burnt offerings and peace offerings on it—your sheep and cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be remembered, I’ll come to you and bless you. 🙏
“‘If you build an altar of stone for me, don’t use cut stones. The moment you use a tool on it, you’ll defile it. 🪨
“‘Don’t climb steps to my altar, so your nakedness won’t be exposed there.’” 🕊️
‘Here are the laws you must set before the people: ⚖️
‘If you buy a Hebrew servant, he’ll serve you for six years. In the seventh year, he goes free without paying you anything. 📜
‘If he came alone, he leaves alone. If he was married when he came, his wife leaves with him. ⚖️
‘If his master gives him a wife and she has sons or daughters, the wife and children remain with her master. The man leaves by himself. 👨‍👩‍👧
‘But if the servant clearly says, “I love my master, my wife, and my children. I don’t want to go free,” ❤️
‘then his master must bring him before God and take him to the door or doorpost. His master must pierce his ear with an awl, and he’ll serve him for life. 📜
‘If a man sells his daughter as a female servant, she won’t be freed the way male servants are. ⚖️
‘If she displeases the master who chose her for himself, he must let her be redeemed. He can’t sell her to foreigners, because he broke faith with her. ⚠️
‘If he chooses her for his son, he must treat her as a daughter. 👨‍👧
‘If he takes another wife, he must not reduce the first woman’s food, clothing, or marital rights. ⚖️
‘If he fails to provide those three things, she may leave without paying anything. 🕊️
‘Anyone who strikes someone and causes their death must be put to death. ⚖️
‘But if it wasn’t intentional, and God let it happen, I’ll appoint a place where the person can flee. 🏃
‘If someone plans a murder and deliberately kills a neighbor, take that person from my altar and put them to death. ⚖️
‘Anyone who attacks their father or mother must be put to death. ⚖️
‘Anyone who kidnaps a person and sells them—or is caught holding them—must be put to death. ⚖️
‘Anyone who curses their father or mother must be put to death. ⚖️
‘If two people fight and one hits the other with a stone or fist, but the injured person doesn’t die and has to stay in bed, ⚠️
‘if they later get up and walk outside with a staff, the attacker won’t be put to death. But the attacker must pay for the time lost and cover the person’s full recovery. 🩹
‘If someone beats a male or female servant with a rod and the servant dies as a direct result, the person must be punished. ⚖️
‘But if the servant survives for a day or two, the owner won’t be punished, since the servant is the owner’s property. 📜
‘If men fight and injure a pregnant woman so she gives birth early, but no further harm happens, the person responsible must pay whatever her husband demands and the judges approve. ⚖️
‘But if further harm happens, then the penalty is life for life, ⚖️
‘eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot, 👁️
‘burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise. 🩹
‘If someone strikes a male or female servant in the eye and destroys it, the servant must be set free because of the eye. 🕊️
‘If someone knocks out a male or female servant’s tooth, the servant must be set free because of the tooth. 🕊️
‘If a bull gores a man or woman to death, the bull must be stoned, and its meat must not be eaten. The bull’s owner won’t be held responsible. ⚖️
‘But if the bull has been known to gore before, and its owner was warned but didn’t keep it penned in, then if it kills a man or woman, stone the bull and put its owner to death too. ⚠️
‘If a ransom is imposed instead, the owner must pay whatever amount is set to save their life. ⚖️
‘The same law applies if the bull gores a son or daughter. ⚖️
‘If the bull gores a male or female servant, pay the servant’s master thirty shekels of silver, and stone the bull. 🪙
‘If someone opens a pit or digs one and leaves it uncovered, and a bull or donkey falls in, 🕳️
‘the person who owns the pit must pay the animal’s owner. The dead animal belongs to the pit’s owner. ⚖️
‘If one person’s bull injures another person’s bull and it dies, they must sell the living bull and split the money. They must also split the dead bull. 🐂
‘But if the bull was known to gore before, and its owner didn’t keep it penned in, the owner must pay bull for bull, and the dead animal belongs to the owner who paid.’ ⚖️
‘If someone steals an ox or sheep and kills or sells it, they must pay back five oxen for an ox, or four sheep for a sheep. ⚖️
‘If a thief is caught breaking in at night and is struck dead, the person who struck them isn’t guilty of murder. 🌙
‘But if it happens after sunrise, killing the thief is murder. The thief must pay back what was stolen. If they can’t pay, they must be sold to cover the loss. ⚖️
‘If the stolen animal is found alive in the thief’s possession—whether ox, donkey, or sheep—the thief must pay back double. 🐂
‘If someone lets their animal loose and it eats up another person’s field or vineyard, they must repay the loss with the best produce from their own field or vineyard. 🌾
‘If a fire spreads through thorn bushes and burns grain stacks, standing grain, or a field, whoever started the fire must pay for everything burned. 🔥
‘If someone entrusts money or goods to a neighbor for safekeeping, and it’s stolen from the neighbor’s house, then if the thief is found, the thief must pay back double. 🪙
‘If the thief isn’t found, the homeowner must come before God to determine whether they stole their neighbor’s property. ⚖️
‘For any dispute over an ox, donkey, sheep, clothing, or any lost item someone claims is theirs, both parties must come before God. Whoever God finds guilty must pay the other person double. ⚖️
‘If someone entrusts a donkey, ox, sheep, or any animal to a neighbor, and it dies, gets hurt, or is driven away with no one seeing what happened, 🐑
‘the two of them must make an oath before Yahweh that the keeper didn’t take the neighbor’s property. The owner must accept the oath, and the keeper doesn’t have to repay. 🙏
‘But if it was stolen from the keeper, the keeper must repay the owner. 💰
‘If a wild animal tore it apart, the keeper must bring the remains as evidence. They don’t have to repay what was torn apart. 🐑
‘If someone borrows an animal or item from a neighbor and it gets hurt or dies while the owner isn’t there, the borrower must repay the owner. ⚖️
‘If the owner is there, the borrower doesn’t have to repay. If the animal or item was hired, the loss is covered by the rental payment. 🪙
‘If a man seduces an unmarried young woman who isn’t promised to anyone and sleeps with her, he must pay the bride-price and marry her. 💍
‘But if her father completely refuses to give her to him, the man must still pay the bride-price required for a virgin. ⚖️
‘Do not allow a sorceress to live. ⚠️
‘Anyone who has sex with an animal must be put to death. ⚠️
‘Anyone who sacrifices to a god other than Yahweh must be destroyed. 🙏
‘Don’t mistreat or oppress a foreigner. Remember, you were foreigners living in Egypt. 🤝
‘Don’t take advantage of a widow or a child without a father. 🛡️
‘If you take advantage of them and they cry out to me, I will surely hear them. 🙏
‘My anger will burn against you, and I’ll put you to death with the sword. Then your wives will become widows and your children fatherless. ⚠️
‘If you lend money to one of my poor people, don’t treat them like a creditor would. Don’t charge them interest. 🤝
‘If you take your neighbor’s cloak as collateral, return it before sunset. 🌇
‘It’s their only covering, the garment against their skin. What else will they sleep in? When they cry to me, I’ll hear them, because I am gracious. 🛌
‘Don’t insult God or curse one of your people’s rulers. ⚖️
‘Don’t hold back the first of your harvest or the first juice from your presses. Give me your firstborn sons. 🌾
‘Do the same with your cattle and sheep. Let the young animal stay with its mother for seven days; on the eighth day, give it to me. 🐑
‘You must be holy people for me. Don’t eat meat from an animal torn apart in the field; throw it to the dogs.’ 🐕
‘Don’t spread a false report. Don’t join with wicked people to give dishonest testimony. ⚖️
‘Don’t follow a crowd into wrongdoing. Don’t give testimony in court just to side with the majority and twist justice. ⚖️
‘Don’t show favoritism to a poor person in a legal case. ⚖️
‘If you find your enemy’s ox or donkey wandering off, take it back to them. 🐂
‘If you see the donkey of someone who hates you collapsed under its load, don’t walk away. Help lift it back up. 🫏
‘Don’t deny justice to poor people when they bring a case. ⚖️
‘Stay far away from false accusations. Don’t kill innocent and honest people, because I won’t declare the guilty innocent. ⚖️
‘Don’t take a bribe. A bribe blinds people who can see and twists the words of honest people. 🚫
‘Don’t oppress a foreigner. You know what it feels like to be a foreigner, because you were foreigners in Egypt. 🤝
‘Sow your land for six years and gather its crops, 🌾
‘but in the seventh year, leave it unplanted and let it rest. Then poor people can eat from it, and wild animals can eat whatever remains. Do the same with your vineyards and olive groves. 🌱
‘Work for six days, but rest on the seventh, so your ox and donkey can rest, and your servant’s son and the foreigner living among you can be refreshed. 🛌
‘Be careful to follow everything I’ve told you. Don’t even speak the names of other gods or let them be heard from your mouth. 🙏
‘Celebrate a festival for me three times each year. 🎉

‘Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. As I commanded, eat unleavened bread for seven days at the appointed time in Abib, because you came out of Egypt in that month. No one may come before me empty-handed. 🍞
‘Also celebrate the Festival of Harvest with the first produce from your work in the fields, and the Festival of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you bring in what you’ve grown. 🌾
‘Three times each year, every male must appear before me, Yahweh God. 🙏
‘Don’t offer the blood of my sacrifice with bread made with yeast. Don’t leave the fat from my festival sacrifice until morning. 🔥
‘Bring the first and best of your soil’s produce into the house of Yahweh your God. Don’t boil a young goat in its mother’s milk. 🍇
‘Look, I’m sending an angel ahead of you to guard you on the way and bring you to the place I’ve prepared. 👼
‘Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Don’t rebel against him; he won’t forgive your rebellion, because my name is in him. ⚠️
‘But if you carefully listen to his voice and do everything I say, I’ll oppose your enemies and fight those who fight you. 🛡️
‘My angel will go ahead of you and bring you to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites. I’ll wipe them out. 🗺️
‘Don’t bow down to their gods, serve them, or copy their practices. Tear their idols down and smash their sacred pillars. 🚫
‘Serve Yahweh your God. He’ll bless your food and water and remove sickness from among you. 🍞
‘No woman in your land will miscarry or be unable to have children. I’ll let you live out your full lifespan. 🕊️
‘I’ll send dread ahead of you, throw every nation you meet into confusion, and make all your enemies turn and run. 🛡️
‘I’ll send hornets ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites out before you. 🐝
‘I won’t drive them out in a single year, or the land would become empty and wild animals would multiply against you. 🐾
‘I’ll drive them out little by little, until your people grow in number and can take possession of the land. 🌱
‘I’ll set your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River. I’ll hand the land’s people over to you, and you’ll drive them out. 🗺️
‘Don’t make a covenant with them or with their gods. ⚠️
‘Don’t let them live in your land, or they may lead you to sin against me. If you serve their gods, it’ll become a trap for you.’ ⚠️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Come up to me with Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders. Bow down and worship from a distance. 🙏
‘Moses alone may come close to Yahweh. The others must stay back, and the people must not come up the mountain with him.’ 🏔️
Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words and instructions. Everyone answered together, ‘We’ll do everything Yahweh has said.’ 🤝
Moses wrote down all Yahweh’s words. He got up early, built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and set up twelve pillars for Israel’s twelve tribes. 🪨
He sent young Israelite men to offer burnt offerings and sacrifice cattle as peace offerings to Yahweh. 🐂
Moses put half the blood in bowls and splashed the other half against the altar. 🩸
Then he took the covenant scroll and read it aloud to the people. They said, ‘We’ll do everything Yahweh has said. We’ll obey.’ 📜
Moses took the blood, splashed it on the people, and said, ‘Look, this is the covenant blood Yahweh made with you through all these words.’ 🩸
Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and Israel’s seventy elders went up the mountain. 🏔️
They saw Israel’s God. Under his feet was something like a sapphire pavement, clear like the sky. 💎
God didn’t harm Israel’s leaders. They saw God, and then they ate and drank. 🍽️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Come up the mountain and stay with me. I’ll give you the stone tablets with the law and commands I wrote, so you can teach the people.’ 📜
Moses got up with Joshua his attendant, and they climbed God’s mountain. 🏔️
He told the elders, ‘Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur are with you. If anyone has a dispute, they can go to them.’ ⚖️
Moses went up the mountain, and the cloud covered it. ☁️
Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day, Yahweh called Moses from inside the cloud. 🌩️
To the Israelites watching, Yahweh’s glory at the mountain’s summit looked like a fire consuming everything. 🔥
Moses entered the cloud and climbed the mountain. He stayed there for forty days and forty nights. ☁️
Yahweh spoke to Moses: 📣
‘Tell Israel’s people to bring me an offering. Accept it from everyone whose heart moves them to give. 🤲
‘Here’s what you can receive: gold, silver, and bronze; 🪙
‘blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair; 🧵
‘ram skins dyed red, sea cow hides, and acacia wood; 🪵
‘oil for the lamps, spices for anointing oil and fragrant incense; 🪔
‘onyx stones and gems to set in the ephod and breastpiece. 💎
‘Have them make a sanctuary for me, so I can live among them. 🏛️
‘Make the Tabernacle and all its furnishings exactly to the pattern I’ll show you. 📐
‘Make an ark from acacia wood. It must be two and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one and a half cubits high. 📦
‘Cover it inside and outside with pure gold, and add a gold border around it. ✨
‘Cast four gold rings for it and attach them to its four feet—two rings on one side and two on the other. 💍
‘Make poles from acacia wood and cover them with gold. 🪵
‘Put the poles through the rings on the ark’s sides so the ark can be carried. 🏛️
‘Leave the poles in the ark’s rings; don’t remove them. 📦
‘Place inside the ark the covenant tablets I’ll give you. 📜
‘Make a cover of pure gold for the ark, two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide. ✨
‘Make two hammered-gold cherubim and put them at the two ends of the cover. 👼
‘Make one cherub at each end, as one piece with the cover. 🪽
‘The cherubim must spread their wings upward, covering the cover. Face them toward each other and toward the cover. 🪽
‘Put the cover on top of the ark, and place the covenant tablets I give you inside it. 📦
‘I’ll meet you there and speak with you from above the cover, between the two cherubim over the ark of the covenant. I’ll give you all my commands for Israel’s people there. 🙏
‘Make a table from acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and one and a half cubits high. 🪵
‘Cover it with pure gold and add a gold border around it. ✨
‘Add a rim around it as wide as a hand, with a gold border around the rim. 📐
‘Make four gold rings and attach them at the four corners by its legs. 💍
‘Put the rings close to the rim; they’ll hold the poles used to carry the table. 🪵
‘Make the carrying poles from acacia wood and cover them with gold. 🪵
‘Make its dishes, spoons, ladles, and bowls for pouring out offerings. Make them from pure gold. 🥣
‘Always keep the bread of the Presence on the table before me. 🍞
‘Make a lampstand from pure gold, hammered into shape as one piece with its base, shaft, cups, buds, and flowers. 🪔
‘Six branches must extend from its sides—three on one side and three on the other. 🌿
‘Each of the six branches must have three cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with a bud and a flower. 🌼
‘The lampstand’s central shaft must have four cups shaped like almond blossoms, with their buds and flowers. 🌼
‘Under each pair of the six branches, make a bud that is one piece with the shaft. 🌱
‘The buds and branches must all be one piece with the lampstand, hammered from pure gold. ✨
